name: Ssu-ma Kuang
bio: Ssu-ma Kuang (AD 1019–1086) was a Sung statesman and the compiler of a great history of China.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: Waiting
poems.author: Ssu-ma Kuang
poems.text:
'Tis the festival of Yellow Plums! the rain unceasing pours,
And -croaking bullfrogs hoarsely wake the echoes out of doors.
I sit and wait for him in vain, while midnight hours go by,
And push about the chessmen till the lamp- wick sinks to die.
